title: 海堤越波模型試驗
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
summary: 以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「弗勞德縮尺條件」與「單寬流量換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Froude scaling conditions" and "Unit-discharge conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling conditions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「弗勞德縮尺條件」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Froude scaling conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。黏滯、表面張力和含氣衝擊卻不能同時自動相似，縮小到細小水舌時必須重新檢查主導機制，避免只憑幾何比例接受模型。 假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。 空氣可壓縮性與液滴破裂對縮尺的反應不同，須分開選擇可外推的觀察量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「弗勞德縮尺條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity, surface tension and aerated impacts do not automatically remain similar; a thin model water tongue may therefore change the dominant physics despite geometrically accurate construction. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Air compressibility and droplet breakup respond differently to scaling, requiring separate decisions about which observations can be extrapolated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Froude scaling conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「弗勞德縮尺條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Froude scaling conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件
knowledge.text: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。黏滯、表面張力和含氣衝擊卻不能同時自動相似，縮小到細小水舌時必須重新檢查主導機制，避免只憑幾何比例接受模型。
knowledge.textEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity, surface tension and aerated impacts do not automatically remain similar; a thin model water tongue may therefore change the dominant physics despite geometrically accurate construction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「弗勞德縮尺條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Froude scaling conditions" is correct?
options: 長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。
重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。
單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。
optionsEn: Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length.
Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
quiz.explanation: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「弗勞德縮尺條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Froude scaling conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「弗勞德縮尺條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Froude scaling conditions", which statement holds?
options: 最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。
反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height.
Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling conditions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「弗勞德縮尺條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Froude scaling conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。比較不同縮尺的關鍵輸出，記錄哪種現象不能由單一重力相似支持外推。另列模型最小水深與最大流速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed. Compare critical outputs at different scales and record phenomena for which gravity similarity alone cannot justify extrapolation. Also tabulate minimum model depth and maximum flow speed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。比較不同縮尺的關鍵輸出，記錄哪種現象不能由單一重力相似支持外推。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed. Compare critical outputs at different scales and record phenomena for which gravity similarity alone cannot justify extrapolation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若模型小到表面張力控制薄層水流，堤頂濺水與集水比例便可能偏離原型；幾何尺寸全部合格仍無法消除這種尺度效應，放大結果也不會自動恢復真實物理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If surface tension dominates thin model flow, crest splashing and collected fractions differ from the prototype. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。比較不同縮尺的關鍵輸出，記錄哪種現象不能由單一重力相似支持外推。另列模型最小水深與最大流速。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed. Compare critical outputs at different scales and record phenomena for which gravity similarity alone cannot justify extrapolation. Also tabulate minimum model depth and maximum flow speed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。比較不同縮尺的關鍵輸出，記錄哪種現象不能由單一重力相似支持外推。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed. Compare critical outputs at different scales and record phenomena for which gravity similarity alone cannot justify extrapolation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「弗勞德縮尺條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Froude scaling conditions"?
options: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
弗勞德數小於某一數字就能直接開放海堤通行。
optionsEn: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access.
quiz.explanation: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「弗勞德縮尺條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Froude scaling conditions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若模型小到表面張力控制薄層水流，堤頂濺水與集水比例便可能偏離原型；幾何尺寸全部合格仍無法消除這種尺度效應，放大結果也不會自動恢復真實物理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If surface tension dominates thin model flow, crest splashing and collected fractions differ from the prototype. Accurate geometry cannot eliminate that scale effect, and multiplying the result does not restore the missing physics. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：空氣可壓縮性與液滴破裂對縮尺的反應不同，須分開選擇可外推的觀察量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Air compressibility and droplet breakup respond differently to scaling, requiring separate decisions about which observations can be extrapolated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若模型小到表面張力控制薄層水流，堤頂濺水與集水比例便可能偏離原型；幾何尺寸全部合格仍無法消除這種尺度效應，放大結果也不會自動恢復真實物理。
knowledge.textEn: If surface tension dominates thin model flow, crest splashing and collected fractions differ from the prototype. Accurate geometry cannot eliminate that scale effect, and multiplying the result does not restore the missing physics.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「弗勞德縮尺條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Froude scaling conditions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若模型小到表面張力控制薄層水流，堤頂濺水與集水比例便可能偏離原型；幾何尺寸全部合格仍無法消除這種尺度效應，放大結果也不會自動恢復真實物理。
單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If surface tension dominates thin model flow, crest splashing and collected fractions differ from the prototype.
Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
quiz.explanation: 若模型小到表面張力控制薄層水流，堤頂濺水與集水比例便可能偏離原型；幾何尺寸全部合格仍無法消除這種尺度效應，放大結果也不會自動恢復真實物理。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If surface tension dominates thin model flow, crest splashing and collected fractions differ from the prototype. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 單寬流量換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unit-discharge conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「單寬流量換算」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unit-discharge conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單寬越波流量的量綱是面積除時間，與整條海堤的總流量不同。重力相似下它按長度比的二分之三次方縮放，先辨清是否已除試驗寬度，才能避免額外乘一次長度比例造成嚴重誤差。 假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。 若沿堤方向越波不均，單一收集段也不能代表整條堤線的流量分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單寬流量換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall. Under gravity similarity it scales with length to the three-halves power. Determine whether the measured quantity has already been divided by width before applying a second width conversion. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance. Spatially uneven overtopping means one collector segment cannot represent the discharge distribution along the entire seawall. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unit-discharge conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「單寬流量換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unit-discharge conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單寬流量換算
knowledge.text: 單寬越波流量的量綱是面積除時間，與整條海堤的總流量不同。重力相似下它按長度比的二分之三次方縮放，先辨清是否已除試驗寬度，才能避免額外乘一次長度比例造成嚴重誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall. Under gravity similarity it scales with length to the three-halves power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單寬流量換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unit-discharge conversion" is correct?
options: 單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。
收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。
單寬越波流量的量綱是面積除時間，與整條海堤的總流量不同。
optionsEn: Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall.
quiz.explanation: 單寬越波流量的量綱是面積除時間，與整條海堤的總流量不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單寬流量換算：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單寬流量換算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unit-discharge conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「單寬流量換算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Unit-discharge conversion", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。
每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping.
Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 單寬流量換算：試驗與驗證
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「單寬流量換算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unit-discharge conversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。再由另一人從基本量綱重建換算，確認圖表與資料檔的單位一致。再由單寬量反算收集段總量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately. Have another reviewer reconstruct the conversion from dimensions and check that plots and exported tables use identical units. Reconstruct total collected-section flow from the unit-width result. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。再由另一人從基本量綱重建換算，確認圖表與資料檔的單位一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately. Have another reviewer reconstruct the conversion from dimensions and check that plots and exported tables use identical units.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。再由另一人從基本量綱重建換算，確認圖表與資料檔的單位一致。再由單寬量反算收集段總量。
knowledge.textEn: Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately. Have another reviewer reconstruct the conversion from dimensions and check that plots and exported tables use identical units. Reconstruct total collected-section flow from the unit-width result.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。再由另一人從基本量綱重建換算，確認圖表與資料檔的單位一致。
knowledge.textEn: Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately. Have another reviewer reconstruct the conversion from dimensions and check that plots and exported tables use identical units.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單寬流量換算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。
重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately.
Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples.
quiz.explanation: 把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單寬流量換算：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單寬流量換算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unit-discharge conversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。圖表數值看似合理時，單位錯誤仍可一路傳入排水需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading. Plausible-looking plots may carry the unit error directly into drainage estimates unless the original dimensions remain visible. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若沿堤方向越波不均，單一收集段也不能代表整條堤線的流量分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Spatially uneven overtopping means one collector segment cannot represent the discharge distribution along the entire seawall.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。圖表數值看似合理時，單位錯誤仍可一路傳入排水需求。
knowledge.textEn: Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading. Plausible-looking plots may carry the unit error directly into drainage estimates unless the original dimensions remain visible.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單寬流量換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unit-discharge conversion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。
若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading.
quiz.explanation: 若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
